# Jingjian · Awesome AI Video Prompts (镜鉴)

> Hand-picked top-tier AI videos with their prompts — searchable by style, mood and genre. 人工精选的顶级 AI 影像与提示词，按画风、氛围、题材检索。

A human-curated index of top-tier AI-generated short clips from X, TikTok and Douyin. Every entry is reviewed by a person, tagged on six facets (visual style, regional vibe, genre, mood, camera technique, use case), credits and links the original creator, and includes the full generation prompt whenever the creator published it. Models include Seedance, Veo, Kling, Sora and others. English pages live under https://daiyixiang666.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/en/, Chinese pages at https://daiyixiang666.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/.

## Data
- [works.json](https://daiyixiang666.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/works.json): every work as JSON (prompt, Chinese + English tags, creator, source URL, model, both page URLs)
- [All tags (English)](https://daiyixiang666.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/en/tags.html) · [全部标签 (中文)](https://daiyixiang666.github.io/awesome-ai-video-prompts/tags.html)
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/daiyixiang666/awesome-ai-video-prompts)

Takedown / contact: yixiang@umich.edu — works are removed promptly at the rights holder's request.
